output_directory.description: Absolute or relative path to output directory for compiled commands; defaults to current directory.

append.description: If true, append new entries to existing compilation database; otherwise overwrite.

force_method.description: Force interception method: either 'preload' (dynamic linker injection) or 'wrapper' (compiler wrapper). If empty, auto-detect.

filter_rules.description: List of include/exclude rules for filtering intercepted commands. Each rule has type, optional pattern (regex), and optional arguments list (exact command-line tokens).

filter_rules.items.description: Not used directly; this is a placeholder field. Real item structure is defined via nested keys below.

filter_rules.type.description: Rule type: 'include' or 'exclude'. Required for each filter rule.

filter_rules.pattern.description: Regex pattern to match against the intercepted command (file or program name). Optional.

filter_rules.arguments.description: Exact command-line tokens (strings) to match against. Optional. Matches only if all tokens are present in the command.

compiler_aliases.description: Map from compiler alias name (e.g. 'gcc') to absolute path (e.g. '/usr/bin/gcc-13').

extra_flags.description: Additional flags to preserve and emit in the 'arguments' array (e.g. custom build flags that bear might otherwise filter).

emit_command_field.description: If true, emit 'command' (single space-separated string) instead of 'arguments' array in JSON entries.
